Closing pre-tag audit for proofbundle 6.0.0, recorded under the definition set on 2026-09-06 in
kraxo/00_standards_regeln/STANDARD_erfolgreicher_abschlusslauf_im_pretag_receipt_20260906.md
(owner decision OA-2ddc2949ac, option 4).

VERDICT OF THE CLOSING ADVERSARIAL DEEP-GATE ROUND: FIX_FIRST. WITHSTANDS_DEEPGATE is NOT claimed
for 6.0.0. Three findings were confirmed and REMAIN OPEN, each documented in RESTRISIKO_600.md and
carried in the signed findings register:
  N16 - action/action.yml interpolates two untrusted inputs into a run: shell body. Byte-identical
        to the public tag v1.0.0; 6.0.0 neither creates nor removes it. A fix on main does not
        reach the documented users either, because there is no moving major tag and INTEGRATIONS.md
        pins an immovable version - that is a SEPARATE register finding,
        KEIN-WANDERNDER-MAJOR-TAG-KEIN-FIX-ERREICHT-DIE-DOKUMENTIERTEN-NUTZER-01, with its own
        owner decision OA-78427865c7, and it is named here rather than folded into N16.
  N17 - the parity gate can rule from the ABSENCE of complaints; on this candidate the population
        is complete, so the capability is open, not its occurrence.
  N18 - pyproject.toml promises "clean skips" for a bare install; the promise is wrong, not the test.

WHY audit_exit_code IS 0 UNDER THAT DEFINITION: the round completed properly and left NO UNKNOWN
findings. The exit code says a run completed; the verdict stands here in the text and is NOT
replaced by it. The definition explicitly does NOT cover an unknown finding, an aborted run, a
timeout, or findings absent from the register.

WHAT "NO UNKNOWN FINDINGS" IS AND IS NOT MEASURED OVER. The closing round was run with six
adversarial lenses, all filed and committed under
office/governance/berkeley_gate/runs/lenses/deepgate600_notafter in the sibling repository. All six
come from ONE model family; a homogeneous panel does not reduce bias, it tends to amplify it, and
the filing tool says so itself.

THE INDEPENDENT un REVIEW, STATED CORRECTLY. An earlier draft of this field said the un review
"returned NO verdict in THREE attempts". That was wrong and is corrected here. Measured on
2026-09-06: attempt 1 (900 s, full diff) timed out with no verdict. Attempt 2 (1500 s, diff cut to
the changed security functions) DID return a verdict, and it was REJECT, with four findings of the
form "correct, but tests missing", against scripts/audit_candidate_matrix.py lines 406, 516, 531
and 697. Attempt 3 (1800 s, with the test diff attached) timed out with no verdict. THE REFUTATION
OF THOSE FOUR FINDINGS IS MINE, NOT un's, and it is a measurement, not an opinion: attempt 2 was
shown only the script diff, and the test diff it was not shown carries seven tests covering exactly
those cases - test_evidenz_einen_tag_nach_der_frist_ist_unzulaessig,
test_evidenz_einen_tag_vor_der_frist_ist_zulaessig, test_ohne_messzeitpunkt_autorisiert_niemand,
test_ohne_messzeitpunkt_wird_die_frist_nicht_geprueft_und_sagt_es,
test_die_frist_wirkt_ueberhaupt_noch_gegen_zu_spaete_evidenz,
test_die_frist_wirkt_auf_dem_artefaktpfad_bereits. So the REJECT is an artefact of the excerpt.
That still leaves NO verdict on the COMPLETE input, so the un review is DEGRADED, never ACCEPT, and
it is recorded as such in the register under
UN-GEGENLESUNG-LIEFERTE-EIN-REJECT-UND-ICH-SCHRIEB-KEIN-VERDIKT-01. "No unknown findings" is
therefore a statement about what those six lenses found, not a guarantee about the round as a whole.

FINDINGS RAISED AFTER THE ROUND CLOSED. The mandatory counter-reading continued on 2026-09-06 after
the verdict was fixed. Everything it produced is IN the register, so it is known, not unknown, and
the definition above holds. Three of those findings are named here because a reader must be able to
see them without opening the register, and because two of them were FIXED IN THIS CANDIDATE rather
than carried forward:
  DIE-ZEREMONIE-MACHT-IHREN-EIGENEN-TEST-ROT-FIXPUNKT-VOR-DEM-TAG-01 (P1) - the SUCCESS of the
        ceremony turned its own suite red: a signed receipt in the tree made tests fail that had
        nailed down the ABSENCE of a receipt as if it were an invariant. FIXED in this candidate.
  MEIN-GUELTIGKEITSORAKEL-IST-SCHWAECHER-ALS-DAS-TOR-VIER-FELDER-01 (P1) - the independent oracle
        in tests/test_c12_1_nicht_anwendbar_vor_dem_tag.py rebuilt three of the seven conditions
        verify_receipt checks and therefore held a correctly signed receipt over a FAILED audit
        (audit_exit_code=1) to be valid. I first classified this as a false-alarm source that could
        never produce a false green. AN ADVERSARIAL LENS REFUTED THAT with a runnable counter-
        example: if the audit_exit_code check regresses out of verify_receipt, the gate accepts such
        a receipt and the test stays GREEN, because its oracle never looked at that field. It was a
        coverage gap at a release-deciding line, not a false-alarm source. FIXED in this candidate:
        the oracle now CALLS the rule, and the anti-parity holds verify_receipt against five defect
        classes including audit_exit_code, schema and version - a calling oracle alone would be
        parallel to the gate and could not catch a regression inside it.
  PR-UMDEUTUNG-DECKT-NUR-ABWESEND-NICHT-ABGELEHNT-01 (P2) - the same test asserted unconditionally
        that C12.1 never sits under FAIL on a pull request. This is not hypothetical: it OCCURRED on
        the frozen candidate, because the committed receipt bound an earlier tree and the gate
        therefore ruled `rejected`, which correctly stays FAIL (finding L5-G6-01). FIXED in this
        candidate: the assertion now distinguishes ABSENT / REJECTED / VALID.
Two further findings from the same counter-reading are carried into 6.1 and are NOT fixed here:
INPUT-DIGEST-WIRD-NIE-NACHGERECHNET-UND-SEINE-HERKUNFT-IST-UNAUFFINDBAR-01 (P1) and
QUITTUNG-UND-EVIDENZ-KOENNEN-NICHT-GEGEN-DENSELBEN-COMMIT-SIGNIERT-WERDEN-01 (P1); the second one
is why this receipt is signed BEFORE the readiness artefacts and not together with them.

ATTESTED RUN on the frozen candidate bf143a00628f25d88ea1a1efad95d126ebe3a733: python -m pytest -q (full suite) in the sibling venv
/home/konrad/proofbundle/.venv with PYTHONPATH=src, on the farmer, 2026-09-06. Result
line, verbatim from the log this receipt binds by audit_output_digest:
  3704 passed, 24 skipped, 950 subtests passed in 1107.51s (0:18:27)
The working tree was clean before and after the run (git status --porcelain empty, untracked
included), and HEAD did not move.

WHAT THIS RUN DOES *NOT* YET SHOW. C6.2, C6.3 and C8.2 are FAIL in the candidate matrix at this
moment, and that is expected rather than hidden: the signed readiness artefacts still bind an
earlier commit, because they can only be re-measured and signed AFTER this receipt is committed
(register finding QUITTUNG-UND-EVIDENZ-KOENNEN-NICHT-GEGEN-DENSELBEN-COMMIT-SIGNIERT-WERDEN-01).
C6.3 stays DATA_BLOCKED for 6.0.0 in any case: the recorded soak is a 300 s smoke, not the full 24 h
artefact, and the artefact says so itself via is_full_soak_24h=false.
